scientific_purpose: Test primary-screen selection as a source of D6 transfer failure: matched baseline, D6 primary auxiliary supervision, cross-CYP primary supervision and D6-primary plus selection-propensity-weighted labels. No unlabeled class is assigned negative. All primary assay values are excluded at each fitting boundary. Evaluate the complete five-model decision procedure on original UMAP/scaffold folds and repeated seeds.
selection_rule: Four prespecified matched model arms, no auxiliary-weight grid or historical-score blend. Label-selection weighting is explicitly conditional on missing-at-random, with cap5. Report actual-policy and historical-ranking comparisons; no automatic candidate veto and no upload.
limitations: Each outer evaluation excludes all test-group measurements before five-model construction and threshold fitting. Effective model training size is 64 percent of development versus 80 percent for blind deployment; same relative algorithm, smaller evaluation sample. Historical cached whole-ensemble scores are used only for matching retrospective rank-rate diagnostics, never to select nested thresholds. Resampled conditional intervals omit training and protocol-selection uncertainty. Primary-screen values are training-only auxiliary targets or training-only selection-weight covariates, not features available for held-out/blind predictions. Primary coverage is partial and selection weighting cannot identify unseen weak-compound outcomes.
